clue.text: Material from directors backing club maybe

indicators.note: the directors stand behind the club, so their word is placed after it

parts.note: a club is one of the four card suits, so it is an example of a card
a company's directors together form its board

explanation.surface: Something is got from directors who support a football club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Club' looks like a sports team, but here it is a playing card.
explanation.definitionFit: Thick stiff paper used for boxes is a common packaging substance.

clue.text: Commanding Officer's to get rid of member of cavalry

parts.note: CO is the military abbreviation for Commanding Officer, with the 's kept
to sack is to dismiss or get rid of someone

explanation.surface: A commanding officer is going to dismiss a cavalryman.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cossacks of Russia and Ukraine were famed as horsemen serving in mounted regiments.

clue.text: Sound of row will continue to be irritating

indicators.note: says the following words are heard spoken rather than read, giving a word that sounds like them

parts.note: a row is a rank, and will shortens to 'll, so the phrase is said as rank'll

explanation.surface: The noise of an argument will go on being annoying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel, but it is a line of people, a rank; RANK'LL spoken sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A grievance that rankles keeps causing bitterness long after the event.

clue.text: Heather goes after second-rate glitzy stuff

indicators.note: the heather word is placed after the second-rate letter

parts.note: B is a grade below A, so it stands for second-rate
ling is a common name for heather

explanation.surface: A woman called Heather pursues cheap, flashy goods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name, but it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Showy jewellery and ostentatious ornaments are known by this slang term.

clue.text: Animal featured in newspaper

indicators.note: the letters appear inside the word newspaper, as an item features in a paper

explanation.surface: A creature appeared in the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A gorilla or chimpanzee is a kind of primate, a beast.

clue.text: Indeed, Myrtle worked with great resolve

indicators.note: the letters of Indeed Myrtle are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Myrtle really did labour very hard.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something with firm resolution means acting in a steadfast, unwavering way.

clue.text: Big beast in Italian river

parts.note: in means fashionable, which is hip
the Po is Italy's longest river

explanation.surface: A large animal is found in an Italian river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' looks like a link word placing the beast in the river, but it means trendy.
explanation.definitionFit: The hippopotamus is a huge African mammal, shortened in everyday speech.

clue.text: Housemaster agitated about very small rodent

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go around the letter for very
the letters of Housemaster are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster in charge of a boarding house is upset about a tiny rat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts the anagram of HOUSEMASTER around V; 'very small' reads as one phrase but splits.
explanation.definitionFit: This tiny European field creature builds nests among cereal stalks, a type of little rodent.

clue.text: History test suitable for a church minister?

parts.note: history is the past
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: An exam on history is appropriate for a vicar.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastoral care is the spiritual guidance a pastor gives to a congregation.

clue.text: Feeling ecstatic, I am joining hospital department

indicators.note: the hospital department is attached after the preceding pieces

parts.note: sent is an old slang word for transported with delight
I'm is the contraction of I am
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital

explanation.surface: Someone thrilled at being taken on by a hospital unit.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentiment is an emotion or opinion, a view held with feeling.

clue.text: Supports provisions for tired workers?

definitions.meaning: props on which something leans, such as an arm or a chin support
breaks given to weary employees to recover

explanation.surface: Props are what is supplied to exhausted labourers.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both physical props and periods of relaxation from work.

clue.text: Reptile troubling a girl a lot

indicators.note: the letters of a girl a lot are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: A scaly creature is bothering a young woman greatly.
explanation.definitionFit: This large American crocodilian is a scaly cold-blooded creature.

clue.text: Feature of sci-fi novel we impart

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters of we impart take a new order

explanation.surface: An author describes a science-fiction element they pass on in a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A distortion of time letting characters jump between eras is a stock device of science fiction.

clue.text: Son with three-wheeled vehicle gets hit

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son in family trees
a trike is a tricycle

explanation.surface: A boy on a tricycle gets knocked over.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike is to deliver a blow, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Food is brought back around holiday site

indicators.note: the reversed letters wrap round the holiday site word
the letters of is are taken back to front

parts.note: a camp is a site for holidaymakers

explanation.surface: Something to eat is fetched back to a campsite.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaded fried langoustine tails are a popular pub dish.

clue.text: Is inclined to enter church to get purified

indicators.note: the inclined word goes inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
leans means is inclined or tilts

explanation.surface: Someone feels drawn to go into church to be made pure.
explanation.definitionFit: To cleanse is to purify, washing away dirt or sin.

clue.text: Boy volunteers to pen a piece of music

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, so the boy and volunteers hold the letter a between them

parts.note: a son is a boy
the TA, the Territorial Army, is Britain's reserve force of volunteer soldiers

explanation.surface: A lad and some volunteers write a composition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pen' looks like writing, but it means enclose.
explanation.definitionFit: A sonata is a classical composition for one or two instruments.

clue.text: Drunk meets lion — it sits by the road

indicators.note: drunk means reeling, so the letters of meets lion stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A tipsy person meets a lion lounging at the roadside.
explanation.definitionFit: A stone marker beside a highway showing distances is a roadside feature.

clue.text: Stuff hidden by miser generally

indicators.note: the letters lie concealed inside the words miser generally

explanation.surface: A miser usually conceals his possessions.
explanation.definitionFit: Stuff is an old word for cloth, and this is a durable twilled fabric.

clue.text: Notice about military engagement getting a grant

indicators.note: the notice letters go round the military word

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
a war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: An announcement concerning a battle wins someone funding.
explanation.definitionFit: Money given officially, such as a student bursary, is a sum bestowed.

clue.text: In turn ace goes wrong, lacking confidence

indicators.note: the letters of in turn ace go astray into a new order

explanation.surface: A tennis player whose ace misfires each time loses their nerve.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unsure of themselves is doubtful and hesitant.

clue.text: Sound of a dove? I'm surprised!

definitions.meaning: the soft murmuring call of a pigeon

explanation.surface: A dove's call, and then astonishment.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a pigeon's gentle call and a British exclamation of wonder.

clue.text: Outside work agent becomes mawkish

indicators.note: the agent word is placed outside the work letters

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A spy working in the field turns sentimental.
explanation.definitionFit: Soppy and mawkish both mean sickly sentimental.

clue.text: Former partner — one to scold or let off?

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
to rate is an old word for to berate

explanation.surface: Should one tell off a former spouse or forgive them?
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate is to clear someone of blame, releasing them from a charge.
